description: A service name that fails SERVICE_NAME_RE or is longer than SERVICE_NAME_MAX (30) is state error INVALID_NAME, not INVALID_CONFIG (D-2026-10-14-04), caught when the connection starts (connecting first, no dial); after an error the next configure() starts again. A name of exactly 30 characters is valid.

expect.lastError: The service name is invalid: use lowercase letters, digits and dashes (not at the start or end), at most 30 characters.
